name: Carettochelyidae
detail: The Carettochelyidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Pig-nosed turtle" — were first discovered in 1887 by Boulenger.

name: Dermatemydidae
detail: The Dermatemydidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Central American river turtle" — were first discovered in 1870 by Gray.

name: Geoemydidae
detail: The Geoemydidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Asian river, leaf, roofed or Asian box turtles" — were first discovered in 1868 by Theobald.

name: Testudinidae
detail: The Testudinidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Tortoises" — were first discovered in 1788 by Batsch.

name: Pelomedusidae
detail: The Pelomedusidae family of turtles — more commonly known as "Afro-American sideneck turtles" — were first discovered in 1868 by Cope.
